blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday denied former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense team’s motion to have the prosecution open a completely new case file with a new evidence list limited to about 10,000 documents. Presiding Judge Joanna Korner arrived at the decision following a lengthy discussion between the prosecution and defense on matters concerning the disclosure of the former’s list of evidence during the tribunal’s fourth status conference. “Your motion that the evidence should be refiled in JWP (Judicial Workflow Platform), and the prosecution limited to 10,000 documents, is at the moment refused,” said […]...
